Git.d: The most widely used version control system: a free program that records the history of a folder as a series of snapshots (commits), with branches and merges. It works offline; GitHub is a separate website that hosts Git repositories.

Repository.d: A folder whose history Git tracks, together with that history (kept in a hidden .git folder). Often shortened to "repo". Copies can live on your computer and on a host such as GitHub.

Staging area.d: In Git, the list of changes chosen to go into the next commit. git add puts changes there; git commit saves everything in it as one snapshot.

Remote repository.d: Another copy of a Git repository, usually on a server such as GitHub, that you push your commits to and pull other people's commits from. The main one is conventionally called origin.

gitignore.d: A file named .gitignore that lists patterns for files Git should not track, such as .env secrets, test reports and node_modules. It does not remove files that were already committed.

SSH key.d: A pair of matching keys used to sign in to servers such as GitHub without a password: a private key that never leaves your computer and a public key you give to the server.

Standard error.d: The separate output channel (stderr) programs use for error messages, so errors still reach the screen when normal output is redirected to a file or another command.

Port.d: A numbered network endpoint on a computer that a server listens on, such as 3000 or 8080. Only one program can listen on a given port at a time, hence "address already in use" errors.

DNS.d: Domain Name System: the internet's directory that turns host names like example.com into numeric addresses. "Could not resolve host" means this lookup failed.

Man page.d: The built-in manual for a command on macOS and Linux, opened with man followed by the command name (for example man ls). Press q to quit.

CLAUDE.local.md.d: A personal, project-specific instructions file for Claude Code at the project root. It loads after CLAUDE.md and should be added to .gitignore so it is not shared.

AGENTS.md.d: An instructions file for AI coding agents used by several tools. Claude Code (2.1.277 and later) reads it directly when the project has no CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md; otherwise it can be imported with @AGENTS.md.

Path-scoped rule.d: A Claude Code rule file in .claude/rules/ with paths frontmatter, so it loads only when Claude works with files matching those patterns.
